footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Empire State Realty Trust: after $29.6M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue was flat at $768M in 2025. Operating income fell 14.5% to $136M, a 17.7% margin.
Net income fell 8.5% to $43.4M, or $0.25 per share. Operating cash flow was $249M and free cash flow $50.6M, versus $88.0M; Empire State Realty Trust returned $31.8M through dividends and buybacks.
